# Fixture provenance

Each transcript fixture is a Wayback Machine (`id_` raw) or live capture,
trimmed to the page head, the "Aired" line and the first two body paragraphs.
Full transcripts are CNN's copyright and are not committed. Index pages are
kept whole; they contain only titles and links.
